newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo rebounds from initial losses.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo rebounds from initial losses.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc closed higher on Thursday, rebounding from their early losses as analysts took a positive view on prospects following an upbeat presentation from the drug company, dealers said.
The stock closed 14p higher at 10.49 stg in heavy volume of 23.8 million shares, making it the most active stock in the London market.

"At first glance the figures looked a little disappointing but the analyst meeting was very positive and they have gone back up," said one market-maker. "We have seen some good UK buyers this afternoon."
However he noted that the stock had swung around violently and could be off again tomorrow depending on how the U.S. ADRs perform later today.
